raster-image.reason: Image tools are usually much faster; verify the output is a real raster image.

presentation.reason: Native and presentation tooling can both meet the contract; try native first, fall back to the capability.

architecture-diagram.reason: Native diagram output is competitive; keep the diagram capability as fallback.

sites.reason: Use Sites when a Qoder Sites descriptor/config is available; otherwise fall back to a local static site.

docs-lookup.reason: Native web lookup is competitive; use the docs capability when it is available and more authoritative.

gui.reason: Desktop/GUI tasks need a desktop-automation capability.

testing.reason: Run/verify can be done natively; use the capability as a fallback.

internal-knowledge.reason: Internal knowledge requires a configured knowledge source.

security-scan.reason: Security scanning benefits from the dedicated scanner; native review is the fallback.

code-review.reason: Code review can be done natively; use the advisory capability as a fallback.

research.reason: Native research is competitive; use the research capability when it adds sourcing.

redis.reason: Redis advice can be given natively; use the capability for deeper RQE/cache analysis.
